## Mercantile Bank Corporation Announces FDIC and Michigan DIFS Approval of Merger of Mercantile Bank and Eastern Michigan Bank


November 17, 2026


GRAND RAPIDS, Mich.


, Nov. 17, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Mercantile Bank Corporation (NASDAQ: MBWM) ("Mercantile") announced today that each of the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (the "FDIC") and Michigan Department of Insurance and Financial Services ("DIFS") has approved Mercantile Bank's application to merge Eastern Michigan Bank with and into Mercantile Bank and to establish the twelve offices of Eastern Michigan Bank as branches of the resulting bank.


The FDIC granted its approval on November 4, 2026, subject to the conditions in its approval letter and order, including that all other required regulatory approvals be obtained before the bank merger is completed. DIFS granted its approval on November 13, 2026. With receipt of these approvals, and, as previously announced, Mercantile expects to complete the bank merger in the first quarter of 2027.


Under the terms of the FDIC's approval, the bank merger must be completed by May 4, 2027, unless the FDIC extends that deadline. The FDIC may modify, suspend or withdraw its approval at any time before the merger is completed, and DIFS may alter, suspend, or withdraw its approval should any interim development warrant such action before the consolidation is completed.


"We are pleased to have received these approvals and to have reached this important milestone toward bringing Mercantile Bank and Eastern Michigan Bank together," said Raymond Reitsma, President and CEO of Mercantile. "We look forward to completing the bank merger, and operating as one bank with a shared commitment to serving Michigan's businesses, families and communities."


**About Mercantile Bank Corporation**


Based in Grand Rapids, Michigan, Mercantile Bank Corporation is the bank holding company for Mercantile Bank and Eastern Michigan Bank. Mercantile Bank and Eastern Michigan Bank provide financial products and services in a professional and personalized manner designed to make banking easier for businesses, individuals, and governmental units. Distinguished by exceptional service, knowledgeable staff, and a commitment to the communities they serve, Mercantile Bank and Eastern Michigan Bank together comprise one of the largest Michigan-based banking organizations with total combined assets of approximately $7.2 billion. Mercantile Bank Corporation's common stock is listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol "MBWM." For more information about Mercantile, visit[www.mercbank.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4824911-1&h=3493949366&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mercbank.com%2F&a=www.mercbank.com) , and follow us on Facebook, Instagram, X (formerly Twitter) @MercBank, and LinkedIn @merc-bank.
